spans.s: भेद m. 1. Rending, tearing; 2. dividing, separating; 3. interruption, disturbance; 4. rupture; 5. chasm, creft; 6. partition, separation; 7. hurt, injury; 8. change, modification, न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेत् Bg.iii.26; 9. hitting (as a mark); 10. disclosure, betrayal, treason; 11. dissension, disunion; 12. difference, distinction, तामगौरवभेदेन मुनींश्चापश्यदीश्वरः K.S.vii.12, ii.4, Bg.xviii.19; 13. form, kind, variety, R.iii.27; 14. dualism (in philosophy); 15. evacuation of the bowels (in medicine); 16. winning over an ally to one’s own party (in politics). See उपायचतुष्टय and M.vii.198.
भेद-अभेद m. du. 1. difference and identity; 2. disunion and union.
भेद-उन्मुख a. on the point of opening (as a flower).
भेद-दृष्टि, -बुद्धि f. viewing the deity and the universe to be different from each other.
भेद-दृष्टि, -बुद्धि f. viewing the deity and the universe to be different from each other.
भेद-वादिन् m. one who maintains the doctrine of dualism.
भेद-सह a. 1. capable of being divided; 2. seducible.
भेदक (I) a. (f. दिका) 1. Dividing, splitting; 2. separating, breaking through; 3. destroying; 4. distinguishing, differentiating.
भेदक (I) a. (f. दिका) 1. Dividing, splitting; 2. separating, breaking through; 3. destroying; 4. distinguishing, differentiating.
भेदन (II) n. 1. Splitting, breaking; 2. dividing, separating; 3. distinguishing, differentiating; 4. disclosing; 5. discord.
भेद्य-लिंग a. distinguished by the gender.
